learning_goal.ja: 加法とスカラー倍を、成分計算と幾何操作の両方で確認する。
learning_goal.en: Relate vector addition and scalar multiplication to component and geometric operations.

learner_question.ja: 係数 -2 は、矢印と成分のそれぞれをどう変えるか。
learner_question.en: How does the scalar -2 change both the arrow and its components?

visual_encoding: Addition combines corresponding horizontal and vertical changes; a negative scalar reverses direction while scaling every component by the same factor.
misconception_risk: 負のスカラーは長さだけを変える
成分を別々の倍率で変える

alt_text.ja: u=(1,2)とv=(3,-1)を対応成分ごとに足して(4,1)を得る流れと、uを-2倍して向きを反転した(-2,-4)を並べる図。
alt_text.en: A flow adds u=(1,2) and v=(3,-1) componentwise to obtain (4,1), and shows -2u=(-2,-4) as a reversed, doubled arrow.
